clauses.code: void calculate_service_times(int n, int times[], int a, int results[]) { int completion = 0; for(int customer = 0; customer < n; customer++) { if(times[customer] > completion) { completion = times[customer] + a; } else { completion = completion + a; } results[customer] = completion; } }
